from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """
    Represents one document parsed from the collection.
    Captures its title and which task-defined cause categories it maps to.
    """
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document (e.g. 《判决文书 1》)")
    matched_causes: list[str] = Field(description="List of cause categories from the provided task list that this document matches")
    evidence_summary: str = Field(description="A short excerpt or summary explaining why this document matches the listed causes")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all parsed document records."""
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
